title: Sbitennik Drink
html:
Quest Giver: Khodebshchik

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Go to the lower side areas off of the 5th and 7th level of Ratsputin's Gulag. There you will find Cinder Hulks, Volcanic Gushers, and Lava Pincers, to kill and collect 15 Volcanic Berries and 50 Fiery Talons. Return to Khodebshchik in Ratsputin's Holding Cell when completed.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Khodebshchik

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Go to the lower side areas off of the 5th and 7th level of Ratsputin's Gulag. There you will find Cinder Hulks, Volcanic Gushers, and Lava Pincers, to kill and collect 15 Volcanic Berries and 50 Fiery Talons. Return to Khodebshchik in Ratsputin's Holding Cell when completed.

Offer:

Have I told you that every time I make this a Cinder Hulk dies? Hah, that never gets old. If you should see a painting in there with a Cinder Hulk running through a grassy field with some brown monsters with big mouths chasing it, you will know what I mean.

Oh, you can also bring Khodebshchik fifty more Fiery Talons and fifteen Volcanic Berries to Ratsputin's Holding Cell anytime you want for me to make you another Sbitennik.

Turn-in:

Sbitennik, we don't spit in it! I will keep saying that slogan. You'll warm up to it like the kiddy pool.

Now run along and allow for these hands to work with this mind to create a masterpeice.

Objectives:

  • Fiery Talons ×50
  • Volcanic Berries ×15

Level range: 75–95
